label: Clinic
summary: A shareable protocol library, synthetic-id cases, the literature behind the protocols and the follow-ups they generate. A draft: it validates and renders, and init refuses it until the three conditions in its README are met.
regulatory_notes: Not a medical record system: case ids are synthetic study ids and never patient identifiers.
No desk produces a diagnosis; triage-support orders questions, never conclusions.
aggregate and train are blocked on every room regardless of mode; no rule can switch them on.
